close_reason: Added Clone, Copy, Debug, Default to EcdsaP256Verifier, RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier, DefaultVerifier.
description: EcdsaP256Verifier, RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier, and DefaultVerifier are public unit structs with no derives at all. Unit structs naturally implement Copy, Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash with zero cost. Missing these means: callers cannot println!("{:?}", verifier), cannot store verifiers in types requiring Debug, cannot use verifiers as Default::default(). All three should carry #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)].
title: Public verifier unit structs missing Debug/Clone/Copy/Default derives
